name: Hash-ribbon recovery momentum long (BTC, buy the hashrate re-cross UP)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (distinct from the two capitulation-fade variants: those BUY the contraction low; this waits for the hashrate to CONFIRM recovery before entering, trading the post-capitulation trend rather than the knife): once high-cost miners have powered off and the survivors' margins repair, btc_hashrate recovering (cross_up above a fitted level) is the physical confirmation that the forced-selling flow has exhausted and network health is rebuilding. Entered WITH a positive medium-term return (ret_Nd above a floor) this rides the halving-cycle recovery leg that the 77% stat describes, but demands the recovery be real before committing capital. DISCONFIRMER 1: if a plain 90d price-momentum long matches the deflated Sharpe, the hashrate re-cross adds nothing and this dies (hashrate must add over price). DISCONFIRMER 2: hashrate is smooth/laggy -> the re-cross may fire well after the bottom, giving away the best entry; KILL if entries systematically arrive after the move. DISCONFIRMER 3: regime-conditional on halving recoveries -> KILL if the post-2023 slice collapses. Must clear DSR>=0.95, maxDD<=25%, net of fees.
catalyst: hashrate recovering after capitulation, confirming the recovery trend
